summary: Verified mobile overflow fix on /login and /registration. No horizontal overflow at any tested viewport (375x700, 390x844, 1920x800). Login page fits exactly (sh=ih=700 on mobile). Registration tab is 26px taller than viewport (sh=726, ih=700) which is legitimate content overflow (Full name field adds height) and acceptable per acceptance criteria. Tab switching remains instant (~107ms). Full login flow with Firebase test user succeeds and redirects to /dashboard with dashboard-stat-plan rendered.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth pages fixed for mobile overflow. Measurements: login 375x700 -> sw/iw=375, sh/ih=700 (perfect). Registration tab -> sh=726, ih=700 (26px content overflow, acceptable, no horizontal overflow). Desktop 1920x800 -> no overflow, branding panel visible. Login flow to /dashboard works.
rca of the issue: Fix applied by main agent (overflow-x-clip on <main>, w-full max-w-[40rem] on decorative glow, reduced mobile paddings) resolves both horizontal overflow (was sw=508 vs iw=375) and excess bottom scroll (was sh=718 vs ih=700). Verified in production build.
